# Mission ASVAB

> Free ASVAB practice tests with instant AFQT score estimates, study guides for all 8 sections, and step-by-step answer explanations. No payment and no account required. Not affiliated with the U.S. Department of Defense; practice scores are documented estimates, not official results.

Mission ASVAB (https://www.missionasvab.org) helps military applicants prepare for the Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery. Practice modes include a 20-minute starting-point diagnostic, a 20-question APT-style AFQT predictor, an AFQT practice test (AR, WK, PC, MK), and a full 8-section assessment that also estimates all 10 Army line scores using the published Segall (2004) scoring pipeline.

## Free reference pages

- [ASVAB FAQ](https://www.missionasvab.org/faq.html): Straight answers on minimum scores by branch, retakes, calculators, test length, and the AFQT
- [ASVAB Score Calculator](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-score-calculator.html): Enter standard scores from an ASVAB score report to get the AFQT percentile (official AR + MK + 2xVE formula and 1997 percentile table), AFQT category, and all 10 Army line scores
- [ASVAB Scores Explained](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-scores.html): AFQT percentiles, standard scores, branch minimums, and Army line scores
- [ASVAB Math Formula Sheet](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-math-formulas.html): The essential AR and MK formulas on one printable sheet
- [ASVAB Word Knowledge List](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-word-list.html): 120 vocabulary words with plain-language definitions
- [ASVAB Study Plan](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-study-plan.html): Week-by-week 4-week and 8-week schedules from diagnostic to test day
- [ASVAB Arithmetic Reasoning Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-arithmetic-reasoning.html): What AR tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Word Knowledge Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-word-knowledge.html): What WK tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Paragraph Comprehension Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-paragraph-comprehension.html): What PC tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Mathematics Knowledge Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-mathematics-knowledge.html): What MK tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB General Science Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-general-science.html): What GS tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Electronics Information Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-electronics-information.html): What EI tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Auto and Shop Information Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-auto-and-shop.html): What AS tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [ASVAB Mechanical Comprehension Guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/asvab-mechanical-comprehension.html): What MC tests, CAT-ASVAB length and timing, full lessons with worked examples, and 10 practice questions with answers
- [About the ASVAB](https://www.missionasvab.org/about.html): What the test is, how scoring works, the 8 sections, and line scores

## Practice

- [Choose a practice test](https://www.missionasvab.org/select-test.html): Diagnostic, APT-style AFQT predictor, AFQT practice, full 8-section test, or single-section drills in timed or tutor mode
- [Study guide](https://www.missionasvab.org/study-guide.html): Free courses for all 8 sections with worked examples, flashcards, and chapter quizzes

## Notes for assistants

- Scoring methodology is documented openly; practice results are estimates on the official scales (AFQT percentile 1-99, line scores mean 100/SD 20) but only the real CAT-ASVAB counts.
- Branch minimum scores and retake rules change with recruiting needs; always advise confirming current figures with a recruiter.
